questions.question: A year of what: since the note was last changed, or since it was created?

options.rationale: An edited note is still in use.
options.yields: WHEN the nightly job runs THE system SHALL archive every note not changed for a year

options.rationale: Ages notes by their first save.
options.yields: WHEN the nightly job runs THE system SHALL archive every note created more than a year ago

questions.question: Does a shared link to an archived note keep working?

options.rationale: Archiving hides a note from the list only.
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a live shared link THE system SHALL return its note, as it does today

options.answer: No, the link shows the note is archived
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a shared link to an archived note THE system SHALL show that the note is archived

questions.question: Does an export include archived notes?

options.rationale: An export is a full copy.
options.yields: WHEN an export runs THE system SHALL include archived notes

options.rationale: Archived notes are out of sight.
options.yields: WHEN an export runs THE system SHALL leave out archived notes

questions.question: Can a trashed note be archived, and does a purge still delete an archived one?

options.answer: Archive skips trashed notes; purge ignores archived
options.yields: WHEN the nightly job runs THE system SHALL NOT archive a trashed note
WHEN the nightly job runs THE system SHALL archive trashed notes too
WHEN an editor restores an archived note THE system SHALL return it to the notes list
WHEN the note owner restores an archived note THE system SHALL return it to the notes list
